_comment: Bundles two recognised published drafts ('demo' and 'notify'), each with a locally-modified copy, so experiment-modified reports two findings and their collapse behaviour is observable. Recognised-but-modified -> the review is NOT aborted: it runs in full and experiment-modified flags each modified draft (error) so the dev gets complete feedback and knows to bundle the unmodified latest upstream. Each finding is anchored to its own experiment_apis entry, so the two carry different loci as well as different names.
